<translate>
'''Goku''' is a [[Special:MyLanguage/Masters|master]] who lives at [[Special:MyLanguage/Goku's House|Goku's House]] in the plains of [[Special:MyLanguage/Earth|Earth]], together with [[Special:MyLanguage/Gohan|Gohan]]. He teaches Fly, Instant Transmission and the [[Special:MyLanguage/Fusion Dance|Fusion Dance]], the Kamehameha and the Spirit Bomb, and three strike techniques. He only trains Good-aligned players.
</translate>

<translate>
== Location ==
</translate>
<translate>
Goku lives at [[Special:MyLanguage/Goku's House|Goku's House]], which generates once per world in a plains biome. Capsule Corp Assistants sell a map to it at trade tier 1 (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Goku's House#Finding it|Goku's House]]).
</translate>

<translate>
== Alignment ==
</translate>
<translate>
Goku needs an [[Special:MyLanguage/Alignment|alignment]] of '''61 or higher''' (Good). Below that he still talks to you, but his '''Skills''', '''Train''' and new quests stay locked.
</translate>

<translate>
== Skills and techniques ==
</translate>
{{See also|Skills|Techniques}}
<translate>
* '''Skills:''' [[Special:MyLanguage/Ki Control|Ki Control]], [[Special:MyLanguage/Fly|Fly]], [[Special:MyLanguage/Instant Transmission|Instant Transmission]], Fusion (the [[Special:MyLanguage/Fusion Dance|Fusion Dance]])
* '''Ki attacks:''' Kamehameha, Spirit Bomb
* '''Strike attacks:''' Dragon Fist, Super God Fist, Oozaru Fist
</translate>

<translate>
Everything is paid for with Training Points, and your race has to allow each skill or technique. His '''Train''' option spawns a Shadow Clone to spar with.
</translate>

<translate>
== In the story ==
</translate>
<translate>
* [[Special:MyLanguage/Classic Saga|Classic Saga]] quest 52, ''End of the Tournament'': find Goku's House and talk to Goku.
* [[Special:MyLanguage/Android Saga|Android Saga]] quest 17, ''Heart Virus Medicine'': give Goku 8 Glistering Melon Slices.
* [[Special:MyLanguage/Daima Saga|Daima Saga]] quest 2, ''Gomah's Wish'': find Goku's House and talk to Goku.
</translate>
